description: Expander for MIX 4, MIX 4 STEREO, VCA MIX 4 and VCA MIX 4 STEREO, making a second mix of the four channels to feed an effect and bring back; it goes to the right of the mix module

params.text: Sets how much of that numbered channel goes into the send mix, from 0% to 100%, and starts at 0%
Sets the level of the returned signal before it is mixed back in; the CHAIN button disables this knob
Sets the SEND outputs to a constant 0V while the button is lit
Turns the RETURN jacks into chain inputs that take the send of an earlier MIX SEND expander, and disables the RETURN knob

inputs.text: The returning left signal, mixed in ahead of the mix module's own MIX level knob
The returning right signal, which is ignored when the mix module is a mono one

outputs.text: The left side of the send mix; polyphonic cables are supported
The right side of the send mix, which is a constant monophonic 0V when the mix module is a mono one

notes: expanders to the left of this one are heard in the send mix and expanders to its right are not, so the order of the chain matters here
up to 16 send expanders can be used with one mix module, fewer if other expander types are in the chain
the indicator lamp glows yellow once the expander has connected to a mix module
